about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm an experienced software engineer with a focus on C# and .NET for cloud-native systems, paired with React frontends when the work calls for a full-stack touch. I am comfortable shaping ambiguous product ideas, delivering the code, and owning the deployment and support story.
Recent roles at Notino, Devteam.sro, mScore, and Oriflame highlight my drive to optimise performance, establish resilient messaging, and keep teams aligned through architecture and review rituals.
summaryPoints: 8+ years building cloud-ready products across retail, fintech, and consulting engagements.
Full ownership of the software lifecycle from requirements through deployment, monitoring, and support.
Hands-on leader comfortable with architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
